slots.title: Sigmoid
slots.detail: Squashes any input into a bounded S-curve, so the output can be read as a probability.

slots.title: ReLU
slots.detail: Passes positive input through unchanged and flattens everything below zero into a hinge.

slots.title: Linear
slots.detail: Leaves the input untouched as a straight line, so the output keeps the original scale.

conclusion.text: The activation decides the shape of the output, not the input.

slots.detail: Pass the sum through the nonlinearity so the output is compressed into the sigmoid range.
